name: geometric_three_period
derivation: Invest 1,000,000 agorot at t=0, single receipt 1,331,000 at t=3. Two-cashflow IRR is the
NPV @ 0%: zero-rate NPV degenerates to the plain sum = -1,000,000 + 1,331,000 = 331,000 agorot.
Simple payback: cumulative -1,000,000 until t=3 receipt; 2 + 1,000,000/1,331,000
Discounted payback @ 0% equals simple payback by definition.
